The run sheet, before the run goes wrong

Consign watches every run against its own sheet and tells your dispatcher which one is slipping, while there is still time to move it.

Start a 14-day trial

No card. One depot, unlimited runs, for 14 days.

It reads the sheet you already keep

Point Consign at your existing run sheet. It does not ask you to re-enter a depot, a route or a driver anywhere else.

It raises a run before it is late

A run that is drifting against its own times is flagged while there is still a decision to make, not at the depot gate.

One screen, one decision

The dispatcher sees what is slipping and who is free. Reassigning is one action in the row, not a trip through three screens.

The three questions every dispatcher asks

We already have a tracker. Why another one?
A tracker says where a truck is. Consign says whether the run will make its times, which is a different question and the one your customer asks.
How long before it is useful?
It reads your sheet as it is. The first flagged run usually appears on the first day's runs, with no data migration.
What happens after the trial?
The trial stops. Nothing is deleted, nothing is charged, and your sheet is still yours.
